title: Yet, Heard

poet_identity.adult: The same Black male Poet throughout: deep dark-brown skin, low faded haircut, neat full beard and moustache.
poet_identity.01_03: Plain black T-shirt, dark trousers, plain dark sneakers; no sunglasses.
poet_identity.04_14: Black tracksuit with thin red piping, black Chelsea boots; sunglasses are a separate component.
poet_identity.young: Young Poet is the same character as a Black boy.
poet_identity.double_and_soul: The double and soul keep the Poet identity; they are instances or special treatments of him.
poet_identity.other_roles: Women and other men are separately labeled supporting roles, never substitutes for the Poet.

information.identity_lock: Adult dark-brown Black MALE Poet, short fade, full groomed beard. Black short-sleeve T-shirt/no glasses01-03; red-piped black tracksuit/Chelsea boots/detachable sunglasses04-14. EX male is rear-only. Young Poet is the same lineage Black boy.
assembly_notes: Working body parts are separate: waist-length armless torso, independent hip connector/rear seat, single upper/lower limbs, hands and feet. Main-pose pages and marked proof bands are assembly references.

Master overview is identity reference only. Corrected separated core and action cards govern assembly. Painted heads in legacy action sheets are expression references; use blank heads and separate features from the core.
Core anchor pattern and the root assembly guide govern pivot placement. Generic prop samples on action pages are references; source-specific root prop sheets are authoritative.

EX dissolution: solid rear-only EX core is state01; detached perforated state02 and torn state03 are here; root supplies final haze FX. Poet receiver/window/suitcase grips and body motions reuse accepted core.

actors.identity: Black mother with warm medium-brown skin, full large rounded natural dark-brown afro, open dark brown eyes, small round gold earrings, mature feminine face, absolutely no beard. She is MOTHER, never the Poet.
actors.wardrobe: long grey knitted cardigan over a teal house dress printed with fine gold botanical flowers, grey fabric slippers
actors.arms: grey knitted cardigan cloth, one capsule per segment, forearm ends at wrist
actors.legs: bare medium-brown skin hidden under separate skirt
actors.overlays: separate lower-garment front and back panels combining teal gold-floral house-dress skirt and grey cardigan tails, from waist to mid-calf, no torso or legs attached
actors.proofs: PHONE LEAN threequarter, one empty grip hand by ear and other cupped; SEATED PRAYER threequarter at chair height, palms cupped at chest, feet grounded
actors.status: explicit Mother02/09; source afro/grey-cardigan identity overrides incompatible updo/coated parent overview

actors.identity: Clearly older Black father, warm dark-brown skin, lined face, close-cropped greying hair and full neat salt-and-pepper beard/moustache; preserve the younger father's broad facial structure. Grey flat cap, no sunglasses.
actors.wardrobe: long grey wool overcoat over dark charcoal three-piece suit, cream shirt and black tie, dark trousers, polished black low shoes; grey flat cap belongs on head plates
actors.arms: grey wool overcoat cloth, upper arm plain and forearm ending at cuff
actors.overlays: separate grey lower-overcoat front and back panels hanging from waist to below knee, front split showing dark trouser hip underneath, no torso or legs attached
actors.proofs: STAND hands behind back, calm; WALK EAST threequarter, one open hand extended at son's shoulder height, empty grip for a separate cane
actors.status: explicit older father role; ageing grey facial detail follows source elder designation
